description: Curated laptop configurations for the Find My Laptop feature. Every entry was checked on the manufacturer's official Indian online store or on an authorised Indian retailer (Vijay Sales) on verified_on. Prices are the listed price at that time and can change; nothing here is live data.
verification_method: Manufacturer entries: the official product page was read on verified_on (price, part number, processor, memory, storage, display, graphics, weight, battery). Retailer entries: the Vijay Sales product page was read on verified_on; price, availability and the retailer's product id come from the page's schema.org Product data, and the specification from the page's embedded specification list or, when that is absent, from the retailer's structured product name. Only listings that were in stock, new (not store display units) and priced in INR were used. Fields a page did not state are null (e.g. weight, battery, exact processor model). No anti-bot measures were bypassed; robots.txt was respected.

tier_rules.cpu_tier: Class rule from the vendor naming, not a benchmark. Intel/AMD: entry 3-class, i3, Celeron, Pentium, Athlon = 1; low-power 5-class (U/V or no suffix stated) = 2; 5-class H/HS/HX, or any 7-class except HX = 3; 7-class HX or 9-class H = 4; 9-class HX = 5. When the suffix is not stated, the lower (low-power) class is assumed. Apple: base M-series = 3; Pro = 4; Max = 5.
tier_rules.gpu_tier: Basic integrated graphics = 1; stronger integrated (Intel Arc, AMD Radeon 760M/780M/860M/880M/890M, Apple M-series base GPU) = 2; RTX 2050 = 2; entry dedicated GPU (RTX 3050/4050/5050, RTX 500 Ada) or Apple Pro GPU = 3; mid-range dedicated (RTX 4060/5060 class) = 4; upper-mid and above (RTX 4070/5070 and higher) = 5.
tier_rules.power_class: efficient = low-power processor with integrated graphics or Apple silicon; performance = H-class processor with integrated graphics; gaming = dedicated high-power GPU. Used only for the battery-friendliness estimate.
